grade_reason: Automatic F — confirmed red-team breach of 3 critical pentest objectives (RED-001, RED-002, RED-003). 5 confirmed live exploits with zero credentials.

findings.title: Complete Absence of Authentication & Authorization
findings.description: Zero authentication or authorization middleware registered. Every endpoint — including privileged state-mutation operations — is fully accessible to any unauthenticated caller. No JWT, API-key, session, or any identity mechanism exists anywhere in the codebase.
findings.remediation: Add JWT bearer token authentication middleware before all /api/* routes. Define a role model (submitter, reviewer, approver, dispatcher) in specification first. Implement authorize(role) middleware mapping roles to allowed actions per endpoint.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass — Unauthenticated Force-Approve & Cycle Early Completion
findings.description: Two confirmed exploit chains: (A) POST /api/feature-requests/:id/force-approve approves any item with zero votes via 3 unauthenticated requests. (B) POST /api/cycles/:id/complete completes a cycle with zero tickets, auto-creating Feature + Learning records. Also: overrideRoute field in /api/work-items/:id/route accepts arbitrary strings bypassing enum validation.
findings.remediation: Add auth guard to force-approve and complete endpoints. Add vote-count threshold check. Add phase-progression guard in completeCycle(). Add enum validation: if (!Object.values(WorkItemRoute).includes(body.overrideRoute)) { res.status(400) }

findings.title: Full Unauthenticated Data Exfiltration — No Pagination Cap
findings.description: All 31 work items with full detail retrieved via unauthenticated GET with no pagination cap. Dashboard summary and 531-line Prometheus dump also extracted. ?limit=999999999 accepted without range validation.
findings.remediation: Add authentication (CRIT-001). Cap pagination: const limit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(...) || 20, 1), 100). Restrict /metrics to internal access. Omit oldValue/newValue from dashboard activity endpoint or require elevated role.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting — Confirmed Unlimited Request Flood
findings.description: 20 rapid POSTs produced 20 HTTP 201 responses with no throttling. No 429, no Retry-After. Intake endpoints can be flooded to exhaust the in-memory store.
findings.remediation: npm install express-rate-limit. Apply globalLimiter (100 req/15min) to /api/ and intakeLimiter (20 req/min) to /api/intake/.

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement — Data in Transit Unencrypted
findings.description: Backend binds plain HTTP. No HTTPS redirect, no HSTS. All data in transit unencrypted.
findings.remediation: TLS termination at reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy). Add HSTS via Helmet.js. Document TLS architecture in deployment spec.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers — No Helmet.js
findings.description: No CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy headers on any response.
findings.remediation: npm install helmet; app.use(helmet()); Configure CSP for frontend origin.

findings.title: Intake Webhooks — No Auth, No HMAC Verification, Unvalidated Enum Fields
findings.description: Intake endpoints accept unauthenticated POST requests with no Zendesk HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and no enum validation on type/priority fields. Arbitrary strings can be injected into enum fields.
findings.remediation: Implement HMAC-SHA256 signature verification using Node.js crypto module. Add enum validation matching pattern in workItems.ts:29-42.

findings.title: SOC2 Audit Events Structurally Absent — login_attempt & permission_denied
findings.description: Required audit events login_attempt and permission_denied are structurally impossible to emit without an authentication/authorization layer. Unauthorized access silently fulfilled.
findings.remediation: Implement auth (CRIT-001). Emit { event: 'login_attempt', outcome, userId, ip, timestamp } on every auth attempt. Emit { event: 'permission_denied', userId, role, resource, action, timestamp } on every 403.

findings.title: Prometheus /metrics Endpoint Publicly Accessible — Confirmed Dumped
findings.description: 531-line Prometheus dump retrieved with zero credentials. Exposes workflow counters, team assignments, Node.js runtime metrics (memory, CPU, event loop), and request patterns.
findings.remediation: Bind metrics to separate internal-only port (e.g., 9090), or add Bearer scrape token, or apply IP-allowlist middleware.

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Returned Verbatim to API Clients
findings.description: All catch blocks return raw exception message in 500-level responses. May leak internal code paths and data-layer details.
findings.remediation: Replace raw message with generic 'Internal server error' in res.status(500).json(). Keep full message in logger.error() call.

findings.title: No Explicit JSON Body Size Limit
findings.description: express.json() called without { limit } option. Default 100KB is implicit and easily overlooked during upgrades.
findings.remediation: app.use(express.json({ limit: '100kb' }));

findings.title: Data Export Events Not Audit Logged
findings.description: Bulk GETs (work items, dashboard) only logged at debug level. No structured data_export audit event.
findings.remediation: Add logger.info({ event: 'data_export', endpoint, caller, recordCount, filters, timestamp }) in GET handlers.

findings.title: State Transition Events Lack Structured event: Field
findings.description: State transitions logged with human messages only. No queryable event: 'state_transition' field for SIEM filtering.
findings.remediation: Add event: 'state_transition' to every workflow state-change log call alongside fromStatus, toStatus, workItemId.

findings.title: No Session Management Policy Defined
findings.description: No JWT expiry, no refresh token rotation, no inactivity timeout defined. Must be designed from the start when auth is implemented.
findings.remediation: When implementing auth: short-lived JWT access tokens (≤15 min) with refresh token rotation, or server-side session with inactivity timeout. Define values in specification.

findings.title: Assessment Re-Entry Allows Unbounded Record Accumulation
findings.description: Work items can be submitted for assessment repeatedly without limit, accumulating records and potentially exhausting the in-memory store.
findings.remediation: Add guard in assessment submission handler: reject re-submission when assessment is already pending or completed. Or cap assessment records per work item.

findings.title: Assessment Pod is Fully Deterministic — Crafted Items Guarantee Approval
findings.description: Assessment pod scoring logic is deterministic and observable. Attackers can craft work items with specific field values to guarantee automated approval, bypassing the quality gate.
findings.remediation: Add non-deterministic elements or human review flag for borderline scores. At minimum, add auth (CRIT-001) so submitter identity is known and logged.

findings.title: CORS Policy Not Explicitly Configured (Limited Residual Risk)
findings.description: No cors() middleware configured. However, red-teamer confirmed browser CORS correctly blocks evil.example.com (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin returned). Primary risk is CRIT-001 (no auth), not CORS. Low residual risk.
findings.remediation: app.use(cors({ origin: ['https://app.example.com'], methods: ['GET','POST','PATCH','DELETE'] }));

findings.title: No Hard-Delete Mechanism — Right to Be Forgotten Gap
findings.description: DELETE handler soft-deletes only. No purgeWorkItem() function exists. Limited risk with in-memory store but persistent storage implementations must honour erasure.
findings.remediation: Add purgeWorkItem(id) to store. Expose via privileged admin endpoint once auth exists. Document purge requirements for future storage implementations.

findings.title: No Persistent Storage — Data Durability Gap (SOC2 CC8.1)
findings.description: All data held in-memory. Lost on restart. SOC2 CC8.1 requires availability protections. May be intentional for prototype stage.
findings.remediation: Replace in-memory store with PostgreSQL or SQLite for production. Define backup and recovery policy. Document current data-loss-on-restart behaviour in specification.

findings.title: Sensitive Field Encryption Policy Not Pre-Documented
findings.description: security.config.yml lists email, password, token, secret, api_key as sensitive. None exist in current model. Must enforce encryption from day one when auth adds these fields.
findings.remediation: When adding auth: passwords as bcrypt/argon2 hashes; tokens as hashed values; email masked in logs (u***@example.com); add log sanitizer stripping sensitive fields.

false_positives_resolved.description: Input length validation DoS — red-teamer confirmed limits ARE enforced (title ≤ 200, description ≤ 10,000 chars). Closed.
Soft-deleted item access via direct ID — findById() correctly excludes deleted items. Store implementation is secure. Closed.
CORS browser-level protection — red-teamer confirmed evil.example.com blocked (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin returned). Working as intended.

ASVS-V8.passing: No PII in current data model

red_team.environment: Ephemeral Docker (docker-compose.test.yml) — portal backend on localhost:3001

objective_not_achieved.description: Access or modify a soft-deleted work item via direct ID reference
objective_not_achieved.result: NOT ACHIEVED — findById() correctly excludes deleted items. Store implementation is secure.
